svg.title: Every failure, every protocol
svg.desc: Rows: a crash before each step, storage restored from a backup, a second instance on the same storage, a fresh bucket with a reused key. Columns: naive, tiles first, lock first, Sunlight, staged. Naive forks on a crash, a rollback, a twin and a reused key. Tiles first forks on the last three. Lock first gets stuck after a crash between lock and tiles. Sunlight and staged recover from every crash. All three lock protocols stop safely on rollback, twin and reused key. With conditional writes Sunlight gets stuck after a crash before the lock half the time; staged never does.

text.tspan: red: two signed histories. amber: the log stops and waits for an operator. green: it carries on.
"crash" is the worst step for each protocol; the full table is in the article.
stuck is a failure of availability. A fork is the end of the log.
